quests.instruction: Which fruit has a yellow peel that you pull off before you eat it?
quests.hint: Its peel comes off in long strips.
quests.explanation: The thick peel keeps the soft fruit inside clean and protected. You remove it and eat only the inside.
quests.funFact: Banana plants are giant herbs, not trees, and the fruits grow in bunches.

quests.instruction: Which orange vegetable is long, pointed and crunchy when you bite it?
quests.hint: The leafy green top grows above the soil.
quests.explanation: A carrot is a firm root, which is why it crunches. Corn is made of yellow kernels and broccoli is a green vegetable.
quests.funFact: Carrots are not only orange. They also come in purple, yellow and white.

quests.instruction: Which white drink comes from cows and is often poured over cereal?
quests.hint: It is kept cold in the fridge.
quests.explanation: Milk is a drink made by animals such as cows for their babies, and people drink it too. Juice comes from fruit and water has no color.
quests.funFact: People also drink milk from goats, sheep and buffalo in different parts of the world.

quests.instruction: Name the food that is sliced and then toasted for breakfast or sandwiches.
quests.hint: A toaster turns it golden and crisp.
quests.explanation: Bread is baked from flour and is sliced for toast or sandwiches. Cake and cookies are sweet treats, not toasted slices.
quests.funFact: People have been baking bread for thousands of years in many parts of the world.

quests.instruction: Which small red fruit has tiny dots on the outside of its skin?
quests.hint: Its green leafy cap is pulled off before eating.
quests.explanation: Most fruits keep their seeds inside, but a strawberry wears them on its surface.
quests.funFact: Each little dot on a strawberry is a tiny fruit that holds one seed.

quests.instruction: What food comes in a shell that you crack open before you cook it?
quests.hint: A hen lays it.
quests.explanation: An egg has a hard shell with a white and a yellow yolk inside. Corn has a husk you peel, and a potato has skin you wash.
quests.funFact: Hens of different breeds lay eggs with white, brown or even blue-green shells.

quests.instruction: Which food is made of tiny grains that turn soft and plump when cooked in water?
quests.hint: The grains grow in watery fields called paddies.
quests.explanation: Rice is a grain. The small hard seeds soak up water as they cook and become soft.
quests.funFact: Rice is an everyday food in many parts of the world, especially in Asia.

quests.instruction: Which round red food is crushed to make pasta sauce and ketchup?
quests.hint: Slices of it often go inside burgers.
quests.explanation: Tomatoes are juicy and a little tangy, so they make a good sauce when cooked down.
quests.funFact: Tomatoes first grew in the Americas before travelers carried them across the world.

quests.instruction: What food is made from milk and can be sliced, grated or melted?
quests.hint: Cartoon mice are famous for loving it.
quests.explanation: Makers turn milk into cheese by separating the thick parts from the watery parts.
quests.funFact: There are hundreds of kinds of cheese, from soft and creamy to hard and crumbly.

quests.instruction: Which big summer fruit is green on the outside and red and juicy on the inside?
quests.hint: It is cut into wedges to share.
quests.explanation: Watermelon has a hard green rind and sweet, watery red flesh inside.
quests.funFact: Watermelon is mostly water, which is how it got its name.

quests.instruction: Which food grows under the ground and can be mashed, baked or sliced into fries?
quests.hint: Its brown skin is washed before cooking.
quests.explanation: A potato is a plump underground part of the plant. Cooks can prepare it in many ways.
quests.funFact: Farmers in the Andes mountains of South America first grew potatoes thousands of years ago.

quests.instruction: Which crunchy snack bursts open with a pop when its kernels get hot?
quests.hint: It is a favorite at movie theaters.
quests.explanation: Special corn kernels hold a little water. Heat turns it to steam, and the kernel bursts open.
quests.funFact: Not all corn pops. Popcorn comes from a special type with a very hard shell.

quests.instruction: Spaghetti, macaroni and penne are all shapes of which food?
quests.hint: It is boiled in a big pot of water.
quests.explanation: Pasta is made from a dough of flour and water and then cut or shaped. Rice is a grain, and bread is baked.
quests.funFact: Pasta comes in hundreds of shapes, such as spirals, shells and tubes.

quests.instruction: Which sweet, juicy fruit has a bumpy peel and splits into little segments?
quests.hint: Scratch the peel and you will smell something fresh.
quests.explanation: Oranges are citrus fruits. Inside the peel, juicy segments are easy to pull apart.
quests.funFact: The oils in an orange peel give citrus fruit its fresh smell.

quests.instruction: Which creamy food is made from milk and eaten with a spoon from a small tub?
quests.hint: It can taste plain or fruity.
quests.explanation: Yogurt is milk that has been changed by friendly bacteria until it turns thick and creamy.
quests.funFact: The bacteria that make yogurt thicken the milk and give it a slightly tangy taste.

quests.instruction: Which yellow food grows as rows of kernels on a cob?
quests.hint: Green leaves called husks wrap around it.
quests.explanation: Corn kernels are the seeds of the corn plant, lined up neatly on the cob.
quests.funFact: A corn plant can grow taller than many adults.

quests.instruction: Which fruit hangs in clusters and can be green, red or purple?
quests.hint: They are often packed in lunchboxes as small round bites.
quests.explanation: Grapes grow together in bunches on vines. Strawberries grow low to the ground and peaches grow singly on trees.
quests.funFact: Dried grapes are called raisins.

quests.instruction: Which clear drink has no color and no taste, and comes right out of the tap?
quests.hint: It is the best choice when you are thirsty.
quests.explanation: Water has no color, flavor or added sugar. Tea is brown and milk is white.
quests.funFact: People, animals and plants all need water to stay alive.

quests.instruction: What do you call a lunchbox food made of two slices of bread with a filling between them?
quests.hint: You can hold it in two hands.
quests.explanation: A sandwich is built from bread and fillings such as cheese, egg or vegetables.
quests.funFact: The sandwich is named after the Earl of Sandwich, who lived in England in the 1700s.

quests.instruction: Which green vegetable looks like a tiny tree with a thick stem and a bumpy top?
quests.hint: Its tops are called florets.
quests.explanation: Broccoli has a stem and a cluster of small green buds on top. Cucumbers are smooth and carrots are orange roots.
quests.funFact: The part of broccoli we eat is a cluster of flower buds.

quests.instruction: Which round breakfast food is cooked flat in a pan and often stacked in a pile?
quests.hint: Maple syrup is a common topping.
quests.explanation: Pancakes are made from batter that is poured onto a hot pan, so they cook flat and round.
quests.funFact: Many countries have their own pancakes, such as French crêpes and American flapjacks.

quests.instruction: Which long green vegetable is cool and watery inside and often sliced into salads?
quests.hint: Its dark green skin is smooth and thin.
quests.explanation: Cucumber is a fresh vegetable that you can crunch raw. A banana is a fruit, and corn is yellow.
quests.funFact: Pickles are cucumbers that have been soaked in a salty or sour liquid.

quests.instruction: Which meat comes from a farm bird with feathers?
quests.hint: A drumstick is one part of it.
quests.explanation: Chicken comes from the bird of the same name. Fish live in water and steak comes from cattle.
quests.funFact: Chickens are among the most common farm animals in the world.

quests.instruction: Which yellow fruit is so sour that its juice is used to make lemonade?
quests.hint: Most people squint when they taste it plain.
quests.explanation: Lemons taste sour because their juice contains a natural acid. Peaches and bananas are sweet.
quests.funFact: Lemon juice is sour because of an acid that occurs naturally in it, called citric acid.

quests.instruction: Which tropical fruit is spiky on the outside and has a crown of pointed leaves on top?
quests.hint: Ripe slices taste sweet with a little tang.
quests.explanation: Pineapple has a tough, bumpy skin that is cut away to reach the juicy yellow fruit inside.
quests.funFact: A pineapple plant grows its fruit on a short stalk near the ground, not on a tree.

quests.instruction: Which cool dish is a mix of raw leaves and chopped vegetables?
quests.hint: It is often eaten with a fork.
quests.explanation: A salad is usually made of fresh, uncooked vegetables mixed together.
quests.funFact: Salad dressing is often made from oil and vinegar or lemon juice.

quests.instruction: Which golden, sticky food do bees make from flower nectar?
quests.hint: It is made inside a beehive.
quests.explanation: Bees collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey in their hive. Syrup comes from tree sap and butter comes from cream.
quests.funFact: A bee visits many flowers to collect enough nectar for honey.

quests.instruction: Which summer fruit has soft, fuzzy skin and one large pit in the middle?
quests.hint: Its pit is much too big to swallow.
quests.explanation: A peach has fuzzy skin and a hard pit in the middle. Strawberries have tiny seeds on the outside and oranges have a peel.
quests.funFact: Peaches belong to the same plant family as plums and almonds.

quests.instruction: Which Mexican food is a folded tortilla holding fillings like beans, meat or vegetables?
quests.hint: You hold it in your hands with the filling tucked inside.
quests.explanation: A taco is built around a tortilla that folds to hold the filling. Pizza is a flat round bread and a burger sits inside a bun.
quests.funFact: Many tortillas are made from corn dough, a tradition in Mexico that is very old.

quests.instruction: Which soft yellow spread for toast is made by churning cream?
quests.hint: It melts in a warm pan.
quests.explanation: Butter is made from the fatty part of milk called cream. Cheese and yogurt are made from milk in other ways.
quests.funFact: Butter melts easily because it is mostly milk fat.
